title: Suspensor Clacks
vars: Six clacks 300-1300 ms apart, each a knock + contact + damped ring, pitched down about nine semitones. A dark medium room. Under it the field: a 50 Hz harmonic stack and two detuned saws, lifting 3 dB.
Four clacks, an octave down, more knock, longer ring. Drone lower and darker.
Seven clacks with a louder, longer metallic ring and a soft fleshy squelch under each. Saws detuned wider, a little grit in the field. Bigger room.
Three clacks far apart, the hum doing most of the work, lifting 4 dB.
Clacks slowly closing up, as the units step faster; the field lifts 7 dB and cuts.
No field: six clacks in the room. The mechanism alone.
